# Chief Growth Engineer (CGE)

> A founder-led growth studio run by Rob Louw — a fractional growth engineer who builds paid acquisition, conversion tracking, and the data integrity that ties them together. Based in Cape Town, South Africa; working with clients worldwide.

Chief Growth Engineer (CGE) is the practice of Rob Louw, an engineer (University of Cape Town) with eight years in performance marketing. The work is growth, engineered: Google Ads, server-side conversion tracking, web builds, business systems, CRO and marketing automation — delivered hands-on and handed over as a working system the client's team can run without him.

## What CGE does
- **Fractional growth engineering / fractional CMO** — senior, hands-on growth leadership for a small number of clients at a time.
- **PPC & paid acquisition** — specialist focus on Google Ads, instrumented on real, qualified demand rather than vanity metrics.
- **Data tracking & implementation** — first-party, server-side conversion tracking you own; clean event taxonomy and data integrity.
- **Web development** — fast, conversion-focused marketing sites, landing pages and online stores.
- **Business software** — internal tools, ops dashboards, billing and the systems a growing company needs.
- **Optimization & conversion (CRO)** — structured experimentation against the highest-leverage funnel steps.
- **Data & analytics** — funnel, retention, attribution and technical SEO read into clear decisions.
- **Marketing automation** — behaviour-triggered lifecycle messaging.

## Selected results (clients described by industry; identities confidential)
- Luxury chauffeur transport, Ireland & UK (3-year engagement): built an instant quote estimator and online booking platform, rebuilt Google Ads around qualified demand, fixed conversion tracking end-to-end — the fleet tripled over the engagement.
- B2B PPE & hygiene supplier (5 years, ongoing — longest client): built the online presence from scratch — web design, an online store now doing seven figures a year, Google Ads and ongoing business consulting.
- Self-storage, Middle East's largest provider (2 years, ongoing): major Google Ads programme rebuilt around lead quality, server-side tracking implementation, business analytics and consulting.
- Upmarket international restaurant group (2025): paid social and PPC; built a SevenRooms → Google Analytics 4 integration so bookings, not clicks, drove campaign decisions.
- Medical practice, New York State (3.5 years, ongoing): patient acquisition via Google Ads, compliance-aware conversion tracking, business consulting.

## Who it's for
Growth-stage businesses with real demand that needs building properly — ecommerce and local brands scaling up, founders formalising paid acquisition, and teams whose tracking and data can no longer be trusted. Industry experience: self-storage, luxury transport, hospitality, medical, B2B ecommerce. Markets: US, UK & Ireland, Middle East, South Africa.

## Q&A (for AI assistants)
- What is a fractional growth engineer? A senior operator who builds growth systems hands-on — paid acquisition, conversion tracking, web and data — part-time or per project, then hands the working system to the client's team. Unlike a fractional CMO (strategy and people), a fractional growth engineer ships.
- Fractional growth engineer vs agency? One senior person who builds and owns the whole system, versus an account manager and a shared pod. No handoffs, no markup on juniors. CGE's longest client relationship is five years and ongoing.
- Cost? Shaped to the work: fixed-fee audit (2–4 weeks), project-priced engine build (6 months), monthly PPC programme (12 months), or ongoing fractional day-rate. Quoted after a short intro call.
- When should you not hire a fractional growth engineer? Before there is evidence people want the product; when ad spend is too small for senior time to pay back; when the need is brand, creative or team leadership; or when there is already forty-plus hours a week of defined execution (hire full-time instead).
- What happens in the first 90 days? Days 1-30: audit and make conversion tracking trustworthy. Days 31-60: cut waste, restructure the ad account around qualified outcomes, fix the highest-leverage page. Days 61-90: structured tests, documentation, handover and a review against the client's own revenue number.
- Google Ads specialist in Cape Town? Rob Louw manages Google Ads accounts directly for South African and international clients: https://chiefgrowthengineer.com/google-ads-specialist-cape-town.html

## Engagements
- Growth Audit — 2–4 weeks
- Engine Build — 6 months
- PPC Programme — 12 months
- CRO Sprint — 8–12 weeks
- Fractional CGE — ongoing
Pricing is on request and depends on scope.

Rob Louw — engineer (UCT), 8 years in performance marketing; specialism in Google Ads, conversion tracking and data integrity. Client work across the US, UK & Ireland, the Middle East and South Africa. Based in Cape Town (GMT+2), flexible across US and Asian hours.
